sources.entry: Sylius - Symfony2 powered open source full-stack platform for eCommerce. (Demo, Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Sylius is an open source eCommerce framework and full-stack platform built on Symfony (PHP).
summary.what_it_does: Sylius is described as an open source eCommerce framework on top of Symfony. The README highlights code quality, a testing culture, and a built-in Agile (BDD) workflow. It states it offers a powerful REST API for integrations and custom customer experiences on any device. Development uses full-stack Behavior-Driven Development with PHPUnit and Behat. Installation is done with Composer, and documentation is hosted at docs.sylius.com. Plugins are found on the Sylius Store marketplace or on Packagist under the sylius-plugin tag.
how_to_run: Install Sylius with Composer (see requirements details in the documentation)
Follow the Getting started with Sylius tutorial at docs.sylius.com
notable: Full-stack Behavior-Driven Development testing with PHPUnit and Behat
Plugin marketplace (Sylius Store) and Packagist sylius-plugin packages
Paid Sylius Plus edition with modules such as OnePageCheckout, B2B suite, multi-store, and multi-source inventory
caveats: Advanced modules such as OnePageCheckout, the B2B suite, and multi-store management are part of the paid Sylius Plus license
SLA-backed support requires a Sylius Plus license
